# NZSalary.com

> Free New Zealand take-home pay, PAYE, KiwiSaver and ACC calculators for the 2026-27 tax year, published by Radif Partners. Every rate is read from Inland Revenue, ACC and MBIE, with the source and date on each page. Calculations run in the browser.

## Calculators
- [Take-home pay calculator](https://nzsalary.com/en/): PAYE, ACC, KiwiSaver at 3.5 % or more, student loan, IETC, weekly, fortnightly, monthly and yearly.
- [Salary calculator](https://nzsalary.com/en/salary-calculator/), [income tax calculator](https://nzsalary.com/en/income-tax-calculator/), [IRD refund estimate](https://nzsalary.com/en/ird-tax-calculator/).
- [Secondary tax calculator](https://nzsalary.com/en/secondary-tax-calculator/), [contractor tax calculator](https://nzsalary.com/en/contractor-tax-calculator/).
- [KiwiSaver calculator](https://nzsalary.com/en/kiwisaver-calculator/), [student loan repayments](https://nzsalary.com/en/student-loan-repayment-calculator/), [employer cost](https://nzsalary.com/en/employer-cost-calculator/).
- [Net to gross](https://nzsalary.com/en/net-to-gross-salary/), [hourly to salary](https://nzsalary.com/en/hourly-to-salary-calculator/), [holiday pay calculator](https://nzsalary.com/en/holiday-pay-calculator/) (8 % taxed as an extra pay).
- [Bonus tax calculator](https://nzsalary.com/en/bonus-tax-calculator/), [redundancy pay calculator](https://nzsalary.com/en/redundancy-pay-calculator/), [final pay calculator](https://nzsalary.com/en/final-pay-calculator/), [pay rise calculator](https://nzsalary.com/en/pay-rise-calculator/).
- [Public holiday pay calculator](https://nzsalary.com/en/public-holiday-pay-calculator/), [overtime pay calculator](https://nzsalary.com/en/overtime-pay-calculator/), [GST calculator](https://nzsalary.com/en/gst-calculator/), [RWT calculator](https://nzsalary.com/en/rwt-calculator/), [provisional tax calculator](https://nzsalary.com/en/provisional-tax-calculator/).
- [NZ Super rates after tax](https://nzsalary.com/en/nz-super-rates/), [Living Wage](https://nzsalary.com/en/living-wage/), [sick leave](https://nzsalary.com/en/sick-leave/).

## Data
- Income tax rates and PAYE for 2026-27: https://nzsalary.com/en/income-tax-rates/
- Tax codes M, ME, SB to SA, SL, ND: https://nzsalary.com/en/tax-codes/
- KiwiSaver changes from 1 April 2026: https://nzsalary.com/en/kiwisaver-changes-2026/

## Method
- https://nzsalary.com/en/methodology/
